system.description:
This spell launches the witch in a long leap and allows her to come safely to earth. Increase stride by four for your next positioning test. Leap 10 paces per success.

Obstacle: 3^. Actions: 4.

Origin: Personal | Area of Effect: Caster/Single T./10s of p. | Element: Anima | Impetus: Enhance | Duration: Instantaneous | Resource Points: 6

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 223
